title: Music Theory for the 21st-Century Classroom
summary: An open-source, web-based music theory textbook designed for modern classroom use, covering topics like notation, intervals, scales, chords, and form with interactive examples and exercises suitable for university-level music education.
problem_solved: Modernizes traditional music theory education by providing a free, accessible, and interactive digital textbook that can be easily updated and shared.
why_valuable: Offers a cost-free alternative to expensive traditional textbooks while incorporating interactive audio examples and modern pedagogical approaches for the 21st-century learner.
